events.text: The Celts have started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Goddess of the Hunt (+1 [ICON_FOOD] Food from Camps)

The Maya have started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Sun God (+1 [ICON_FOOD] Food for each [ICON_RES_WHEAT] Wheat, Banana, [ICON_RES_CITRUS] Citrus, [ICON_RES_COCOA] Cocoa, and [ICON_RES_PINEAPPLE] Pineapple resource)

Japan has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: God of the Sea (+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production from Fishing Boats and Atolls, a free Work Boat appears near the [ICON_CAPITAL] Capital)

Poland has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Monument to the Gods (+20% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production of Ancient/Classical/Medieval Wonders. Ancient/Classical/Medieval Wonders (except National Wonders) provide +1 [ICON_HAPPINESS_1] happiness)

Siam has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Goddess of Love (+1 [ICON_HAPPINESS_1] Happiness from cities with population of 4+ and a free [ICON_WORKER] Worker appears near the [ICON_CAPITAL] Capital)
Assyria has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Warriors' Songs (+1 [ICON_FOOD] Food and +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture from [ICON_BUILDING_BARRACKS] Barracks)
A golden age begins for the Siamese civilization.
A golden age begins for the Polish civilization.
